evals.prompt: Write an ACM script to remove the legacyProp property from all product pages under /content/acme.
evals.expected_output: Manual script with rootPath and dryRun inputs (dryRun true by default), canRun returning conditions.always(), writes wrapped in repo.dryRun, a query by node type and sling:resourceType condition, deleteProperty (not removeProperty), context.checkAborted() in the loop, start and summary log lines.

evals.prompt: Give the editors group read access to /content/dam/acme, applied automatically on deployment.
evals.expected_output: Automatic script with conditions.changed() (optionally && isInstanceAuthor()), acl.createGroup with skipIfExists() or acl.getGroup, permissions set via allow { path = ...; permissions = ['jcr:read'] }, no purge(), logging.

evals.prompt: Create a nightly ACM job that deletes workflow instances older than 30 days.
evals.expected_output: Automatic script with scheduleRun returning schedules.cron(...) with seconds field, a suitable canRun, a query or Java API call limited to completed instances older than the cutoff, context.checkAborted() in loops, a dryRun option or an explicit note about it, progress and summary logging. Uses only methods present in the API reference.

evals.prompt: Export a CSV of all pages under /content/acme/en with their template and last modified date.
evals.expected_output: Manual script with an outputs.file report (label, downloadName, report.out.println), CSV values escaped, context.checkAborted(), a text summary output, read-only (no dryRun needed).
